data.synopsis:
Shasha and Milo are the newly activated Crescent Moon Guardians. Imbued with the power to transform between human, cat and a formidable hybrid form, Shasha and Milo are tasked with protecting Crescent Island from the dark forces that lurk beneath it... whilst navigating the daily complexities of preteen life.

(Source: Pingo)
